title: fix(plugin-map): a failed map style degrades to the record list with translated notices
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9WYHAKgVAFQD9wXNccP3Em1)_
Part of #25889
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Item 1 of the card only: a failed style or tile load degrades to the record list, and the map's notices read the translation bundle. Item 2, a deployment-level map style setting, needs a new settings key and a Console CSP change and is split to #26001; #25889 remains open for it.

## What changed

- **`ui/packages/plugin-map/src/ObjectMap.tsx`.** MapLibre's `error` event (style URL unreachable, tile host blocked) used to keep the map mounted: a grey canvas with the markers floating over nothing, under an English alert saying the markers were "still listed in the search box" (no such listing existed) and asking for "a custom map style for production use" (no such setting exists). Now the error swaps `MapGL` out for the record list the WebGL2 fallback already drew: the same `filteredMarkers`, searchable from the box above, each row taking the marker's click path. The alert keeps MapLibre's reason and names a remedy that exists: a view with its own `style` is told to check that URL, a view on the public default is told to ask an administrator to set a map style for the view. A "Try the map again" button clears the error and remounts the map; the WebGL2 case has no retry. The list carries `data-testid="map-style-fallback"` for the style case and keeps `map-webgl2-fallback` for the WebGL2 case.
- **Translated notices.** The style alert (two variants plus a fallback reason when MapLibre gives no message), the WebGL2 alert, the list's accessible name and empty text, the retry button and the "excluded for missing or invalid coordinates" count go through `useObjectTranslation` (from `@object-ui/react`, already a dependency) with inline English defaults equal to the `en` values. The count is written "Label: N" so it needs no plural family across the ten packs.
- **`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`.** Eight `element.map.*` keys appended in all ten packs; nothing renamed or removed.
- **`ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/ariaLabelLiteralCensus-12145.test.ts`.** `Locations` leaves the plugin-map row of the frozen literal-`aria-label` backlog, as the census requires in the commit that translates it. This file is outside the claim's declared surface; it is a one-word deletion the census forces.
- **`scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json`.** Re-recorded with `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` (registry source hash only).
- **`.changeset/25889-map-style-failure-notice.md`.** `patch` for `@object-ui/plugin-map` and `@object-ui/i18n`.

## Tests

All at head `79dcecfd` (latest `main` merged in, manifest record re-recorded after the merge) unless marked.

- `packages/plugin-map/` + `packages/i18n/` (vitest, `--maxWorkers=2`, under the verify lock): Test Files 129 passed (129), Tests 1627 passed, 13 skipped (plugin-map alone at `f4d90cad`: 42 files, 274 tests).
- New `ObjectMap.styleFailureList-25889.test.tsx` (9 cases): the map is replaced and removed exactly once (a stub whose effect cleanup stands for react-map-gl's `map.remove()`), the notice text for both style variants and the no-message case, search and click path on the list, retry remounts a fresh map with its markers, and unmounting after the swap does not remove the map a second time and reaches no error boundary.
- New `ObjectMap.noticesI18n-25889.test.tsx`: under a real `I18nProvider` at zh-CN, the excluded count, the style alert, the retry button and the list's name are Chinese.
- Flipped: `ObjectMap.webgl2Controls-11819.test.tsx`'s style-failure case now asserts the swap (was: map and markers kept). `ObjectMap.webgl2Fallback-11819.test.tsx` gains "no retry button".
- Reverse run (at `f4d90cad`): with the base `ObjectMap.tsx` restored (trap-guarded, restore proven by blob hash), the three changed files went red, Tests 11 failed, 2 passed; restored, green.
- `type-check` for `@object-ui/plugin-map` and `@object-ui/i18n`: 0 errors; the plugin-map test program lists both new files.
- `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys` (ui scripts): exit 0. eslint over the touched files: 0 errors.
- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 46 derived families run, each exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 46 derived, 46 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (derived zero).

NOT MEASURED: a real MapLibre map that started and then failed its style, being removed in a browser. happy-dom provides no WebGL2, so the real `map.remove()` on a started map is stood in for by the stub's cleanup; the removal path for a map that never started stays covered by the real-MapLibre `webgl2Fallback` file.

## Acceptance notes

- A tile error on a map whose style loaded also degrades to the list (MapLibre reports both through the same `error` event). The retry button is the way back after a transient failure.
- Still English in the same view, not touched here: the search placeholder "Search locations…", "Loading map...", the geolocation button and its two error strings, the popup's Edit / Delete, the mobile sheet's labels and the overlay title "Location Details". The "Map configuration required" refusal stays a literal on purpose (an authoring diagnostic whose words are metadata keys); its comment now says that instead of "this package carries no i18n dependency", which was no longer true.
